en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a river crossing with a wooden raft or pontoon ferry carrying people across the water. Logs float in the river and simple wooden structures line the banks. In the background there is a town with trees, low houses and a church-like building, backed by a large wooded hill. The caption at the top reads in Romanian: "Piatra-Neamţu – Trecarea cu pluta peste Vale."
